Benefits

- Collaboration on an innovative and exciting product
- A great and motivated team is looking forward to getting to know you
- You will have the opportunity to work independently, autonomously and flexibly
- Flexible working hours with home office option
- You will benefit from first-class future prospects and freedom to shape your own future
- Extensive opportunities for professional and personal development
- Open corporate culture characterized by team spirit with cooperative management style and flat hierarchies
- Provision of top equipment to enable productive and efficient work
- Company pension plan, Christmas bonus, training courses, events

Assignments

- Ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance of the container platform
- Maintenance, further development, and administration of the platform infrastructure
- Automation of deployments and operational processes using CI/CD pipelines
- Design, implementation, and optimization of monitoring solutions (e.g., Grafana, Elastic Stack)
- Analysis and resolution of incidents, including (security) incident response
- Implementation and monitoring of security measures to ensure the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of the software landscape
- Threat and vulnerability management as well as deployment management
- Creation and maintenance of technical documentation and manuals
- Training and awareness programs for teams on application security topics
- Supporting internal teams with technical inquiries

Qualifications

- Completed training as an IT specialist in system integration or a comparable qualification
- In-depth knowledge of DevOps practices and tools, as well as cloud technologies such as Linux, Postgres, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, Azure, and DigitalOcean
- Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform, Pulumi, and Ansible
- Practical experience with security tools (e.g., SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk) and security standards and frameworks (e.g., OWASP, ISO 27001, SOC)

- Analytical and solution-oriented mindset, as well as a structured, goal-oriented work approach with a high level of initiative
- Strong and precise German and English skills, both spoken and written

Your tasks

- As an experienced Fullstack Developer (all genders), you design and build scalable web applications as well as reusable components for our e-commerce, PIM, and CMS solutions. Occasionally, you'll liaise directly with clients on technical questions
- Depending on the project, you'll work with a modern tech stack including PHP (Symfony), Twig, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and Storybook

Your experience

- You have several years of experience with a modern tech stack such as Node.js, TypeScript, React, Docker, and GraphQL, and are confident working with PHP and PHP-based frameworks like Symfony
- Solid knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL, along with confident use of Git, form the foundation of your work
- You're comfortable with CSS frameworks like Tailwind, templating languages like Twig, and building reusable UI components
- You're solution-oriented, reliable, and a strong team player, with very good English skills

Our benefits

Our employees should feel comfortable all the time. That's why we try to make the working environment as pleasant as possible.

- Mental Health: To support the mental health of our colleagues, we offer anonymous, free access to webinars and group sessions as well as individual consultations with coaches, psychologists or psychotherapists via the platform Nilo. Mental health is not a luxury, but the cornerstone of our happiness.
- Workation: valantic DXA offers you the possibility to use your mobile work quota also Europe-wide. For example, you can extend your vacation and your vacation feeling.
- Modern working environment: No matter where our employees work - at one of our 4 locations, in the home office or on the road - we attach great importance to the best hardware and a modern working environment. Our offices are equipped with the latest technology and we offer the support of an external service provider for home office equipment.
- Locations: If you want to manage modern projects, you can't squat in the last hole! All our offices are equipped with the latest technology and reflect the flair of the location.
- Teamevents: Numerous joint team events bring us all together again as a group, even if we work across Europe. From Christmas and summer parties, to joint activities and mountain festivals - there's a lot going on. Check out our Instagram channel for more insights.
- Corporate Benefits: At valantic DXA you can benefit from numerous offers and discounts at many companies. Simply register, browse and store. This applies to new shoes as well as gardening tools, vacations or the latest console...
- Mobile Work: Thanks to our flexible mobile work arrangement, you can work between 40 - 130 days per year outside your contracted work location, depending on your work model. Perfect for optimally combining job and family.
- Bike: With the JobRad program, you can put together the bike of your dreams and lease it from the dealer of your choice. The great thing about it is that the leasing amounts are deducted from your gross salary, thus optimizing your salary.
- Working environment: Noisy open-plan office with no decoration or opportunities for mental downtime? Not with us! At all our locations, we try to make the working environment as interesting, pleasant and inspiring as possible. And if you have a crazy idea for an improvement, let us know!
- Office Dog: It doesn't matter whether you can't organize care for your dog or need your four-legged friend as emotional support - everything is welcome here, from small to large. We offer you our own dog-friendly offices. There is only one iron rule: everyone cleans up their own mess...
- EGYM Wellpass (available only in Germany): With our EGYM Wellpass offer, you can get yourself up to operating temperature before work, strengthen your muscles during your lunch break or blow off steam in the evening. The EGYM Wellpass includes over 6000 studios throughout Germany.
- Flexible Working Hours: Yes, we have core working hours during which our chapters must be available. However, we can coordinate with each other and start later or finish earlier. Depending on what the current situation requires.
- Further Education: Acquiring new skills or deepening your knowledge to expert level is a prerequisite for us. To ensure that you continue to learn as much as possible, we offer you a wide range of opportunities. If it makes sense, it will be done!

jobs.occupation: Early Career — DFT Engineer (M, F, D) (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
jobs.description:
Description

As a DFT engineer, you will lead the complete DFT solution for a chip project, with responsibilities spanning all aspects of semiconductor development.

Responsibilities

- You will create DFT specifications, create verification plans, and define the SoC test interface.
- You will develop and implement the DFT architecture and own its integration into large SoC blocks — including IP integration, system and control bus connectivity, and the integration of memories and hard macros.
- You will implement testbenches, generate directed and constrained-random tests, debug failures, run gate-level simulations, and close coverage.
- You will also generate structural test vectors, run synthesis and timing closure and work closely with Chip Architecture, DV, Physical Design, and Power teams to achieve first-tapeout success.
- Additional responsibilities include supporting STA, physical, power, and logical analysis for DFT modes, partnering with Test Engineers to bring up test vectors on silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Knowledge of Verilog and/or VHDL, and familiarity with simulators and waveform debugging tools.
- Exposure to a scripting language such as Python, TCL, or Perl, including familiarity with leveraging generative AI tools to support scripting and engineering workflows.
- Ability to fluently speak and write in English.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to industry-standard DFT concepts such as ATPG, JTAG, or MBIST.
- Knowledge of general logic design principles.
- Exposure to design verification methodologies, coverage analysis, and assertions.
- Good problem-solving and communication skills.
- Experience in large SoC design or verification — a plus.

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

Please upload your CV in English.

How you'll impact.

Proactive 1st Level Support. You are the first point of contact for all colleagues across our global offices. By working closely with your team, you ensure fast and solution-oriented IT support, on-site and remotely.

Reliable Client Management. You manage our client devices with precision, from Windows laptops to iOS smartphones. You handle rollouts, updates, and provide troubleshooting when needed, ensuring our IT runs smoothly every day.

Strong Office Infrastructure. You take ownership of maintaining our workplace and meeting room infrastructure, whether it's hardware setup or audio-visual systems,

Hands-On Project Involvement. You contribute to change initiatives and project work, and optimizing our internal IT environment.

Ownership of Key Processes. You take responsibility for recurring operational tasks such as managing internal ordering processes and asset tracking.

Empowered by Teamwork. You’ll join a dynamic and motivated IT team that values early responsibility and shared growth. Your ideas are welcome and your impact will be visible from day one.

What you'll bring.

A completed apprenticeship as an IT specialist in system integration or IT systems electronics technician or relevant professional experience.

Proven experience in end-user support, particularly in Windows environments, experience with iOS devices is an advantage.

A conscientious and flexible working style with a strong sense of responsibility.

A genuine enjoyment in supporting colleagues with professionalism, patience, and a service mindset.

You communicate fluently in English and German.

What we'll offer.

From day one, we invest in your grwoth and well-being - because your success fuels ours.

- Tailored training programs and personalized coaching to help you develop your strengths, deepen your expertise, and grow with confidence.
- Flexible working models that support your personal needs, including family, life stages, and mobility preferences.
- Access to mental coaching and well-being resources that build resilience and support you to thrive - professionally and personally.
- A rewarding Employee Referral Program - because the best teams grow through trusted connections.
- Comprehensive insurance coverage for security and peace of mind.
- Individual mobility packages that support flexibility and convenience.
- Seasonal and team events to foster collaboration and celebrate success – together.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 1739672

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Our network of around 400,000 people around the world offers you every opportunity to grow, develop, specialize and pursue your professional strengths and interests. We believe that the right career path is as individual as you are.

Your role
Within People Advisory Services Tax, we support organizations in managing and transforming their global mobility programs. Our integrated approach brings together hands-on operational assignment delivery with strategic mobility transformation, helping clients provide an effective employee experience while continuously evolving how mobility operates. We are looking for a (Senior) Consultant to join our Mobile Talent Operate and Mobility Transformation team. The role focuses on the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, while also supporting strategic transformation projects that shape the future of global mobility. Your wide-ranging responsibilities in our team will include:

- Act as a central point of contact for the mobility teams of multinational clients in Germany and abroad
- Coordinate services across the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, including expatriate tax, social security compliance, immigration, global compensation management and third-party relocation providers
- Prepare and review assignment-related deliverables such as cost estimates, balance sheet calculations, assignment letters and mobility documentation
- Contribute to Mobility Transformation projects, including project management activities, the development or refresh of mobility programs and assignment policies, and participation in workshops, strategic meetings and client decision-making
- Contribute to proposals, marketing materials, articles and thought leadership, and identify opportunities to provide additional services that benefit our clients

Your skillset

- A university degree in Business Administration, Management, Human Resources, or a related field, combined with a structured and organized approach to work and the ability to manage multiple projects and clients simultaneously
- A strong interest in global mobility, with enthusiasm for combining operational assignment delivery with strategic transformation initiatives, complemented by a client-focused mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality, accurate work, even under tight deadlines

Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. We are looking for people to help us shape the future and create a working environment based on trust.

Your benefits
At EY, you will work in high-performing, interdisciplinary teams with innovative technologies. We support you in your various life situations with our flexible and inclusive working environment. Inspiring colleagues as well as training and development opportunities both on and off the job will empower you to grow and develop skills that will equip you for the future. We guarantee a steep learning curve.More about our benefits  .

Apply today!
You can find further information on the application process at EY on ourCareers page  .
At EY, we emb  diversity and welcome all applications. Let us know in good time if we can help you by offering an accessible application process.
Any questions? Just call +49 6196 996 10005 and our Recruitment Center will be happy to help.

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes

jobs.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHY At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder. THE WHAT
• Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
• Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
• Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
• Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
• Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE
• 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
• Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
• Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
• Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
• Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
• Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
• Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER
• Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
• Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.
• Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.
• Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.
• Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.
• Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.
• Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

As Offshore LTP Project Manager in SE GS AP PM C3, you play a key role in delivering Gas Turbine Long-Term Program projects and in building long-term customer success in Korea, Japan, and Australia.

You drive project execution from a technical, commercial, and operational perspective and work closely with your onshore Project Management partners to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards. In doing so, you act as a key interface between the customer and internal stakeholders and help turn project challenges into practical solutions.

In your daily work, you collaborate across functions including Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, Sales, and Onshore Project Management. Your ability to stay structured, build trust, and keep execution on track contributes directly to customer satisfaction and business success.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Project Ownership:Take full responsibility for the execution of assigned Gas Turbine LTP projects across the Asia Pacific region.
* Customer Success:Build strong customer relationships through reliable execution, transparent communication, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
* Execution Excellence:Ensure delivery in line with project scope, schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.
* Commercial Performance:Actively manage project cost, invoicing, cash flow, risks and opportunities, claims, and change order potential in close cooperation with Commercial Project Manager.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with Onshore Project Management, Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, and Sales to achieve project and business targets.
* Problem Solving:Identify risks and issues early, drive mitigation actions, and support timely resolution of technical, operational, and commercial topics.
* Continuous Improvement:Apply project management standards and tools with discipline and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and ways of working.

What You Bring

* BS in Engineering or related field of study
* Significant professional experience in project management, ideally in Gas Turbine service business and/or Long-Term Program execution
* Strong technical and commercial understanding of project execution in the power generation industry
* Experience managing customer interfaces and coordinating cross-functional teams in an international business environment
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage technical, operational, commercial, and customer-related topics in a structured and professional manner
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic environment

* Business proficiency in both German and English

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
